outlook.statement: The Company expects to increase its revenue and the profitability during the year as the business has started showing growth and the economy as a whole has moved towards revival and future of the Company looks very bright. There is no dearth of demand and the Company is well shaped to cope up itself with the market expectations.

The outlook for the aluminium industry remains positive, supported by robust infrastructure spending, rapid urbanization, increased adoption of electric vehicles, expansion of renewable energy, and growing emphasis on sustainability. Continued policy support, technological advancements, and rising demand for recyclable and lightweight materials are expected to drive steady growth in aluminium consumption over the medium to long term.

India remains one of the fastest-growing aluminium markets globally, driven by sustained investments in infrastructure, housing, renewable energy, transportation, electrical transmission, and manufacturing. Government initiatives such as the National Infrastructure Pipeline (NIP), PM Gati Shakti, Make in India, and the Production Linked Incentive (PLI) schemes are expected to support long-term demand for aluminium products.

The Company continues to implement and strengthen the strategic initiatives undertaken in the previous financial year with the objective of enhancing operational efficiency, expanding its market presence, and improving profitability over the medium to long term.

Expansion of Customer Base: The Company continues to focus on developing new customers in both domestic and international markets, with particular emphasis on increasing sales of value-added products such as Colour Coated Aluminium Sheets/Coils and Embossed Aluminium Sheets/Coils.
Enhancement of Product Quality: Continuous efforts are being made to improve the quality of finished products through process improvements, quality control measures, and technological enhancements.
Strengthening Domestic Market Presence: The Company is expanding its footprint in the domestic market with a focused strategy to increase sales across the Northern and Southern regions of India.

Modernization of Manufacturing Facilities: The Company is undertaking the revamping and modernization of its plant and machinery to improve operational efficiency, enhance production capabilities, reduce conversion costs, and ensure optimum utilization of manufacturing resources.

Cost Optimization Initiatives: Various cost rationalization measures continue to be implemented across the organization including optimization of power and fuel consumption, reduction in administrative expenses, effective manpower planning, rationalization of contractual and permanent workforce, and improved planning of scheduled repairs and maintenance.

Diversification of Raw Material Sourcing: The Company is actively developing and strengthening relationships with new suppliers of raw materials across Australia, the United Kingdom, the United Arab Emirates, and other European countries.

Automation and Cost Reduction Initiatives: The Company continues to invest in automation and process optimization initiatives to improve operational efficiency and reduce manufacturing costs, including installation and upgradation of conveyor belt systems and material handling equipment.

Introduction of New Products in Different Markets: The Company continues to focus on expanding its product portfolio by introducing innovative and value-added aluminium products across domestic and international markets.

Research & Development – Product Stability and Durability: The Company continues to strengthen its research and development capabilities with a focus on enhancing the stability, durability, and overall performance of its products.

The Company continues to monitor the evolving situation including finalisation of the Central and State Rules, along with further clarifications from the Government on the new Labour Codes and would provide appropriate accounting effect on the basis of such developments, as needed.

risks: Volatility in Raw Material Prices: The aluminium industry is significantly influenced by fluctuations in the prices of primary aluminium, alumina, and other key raw materials.

Energy Cost Risk: Energy constitutes a substantial component of aluminium production costs. Any significant increase in electricity, fuel, or natural gas prices may adversely impact operating costs and overall profitability.

Global Economic Uncertainty: Macroeconomic challenges, including inflationary pressures, high interest rates, geopolitical tensions, and disruptions in global trade, may affect industrial activity and demand for aluminium across key end-user industries.

Demand Fluctuations: Demand for aluminium products is closely linked to the performance of sectors such as construction, automotive, electrical, infrastructure, packaging, and consumer durables. Any slowdown in these sectors may adversely affect sales volumes.

Foreign Exchange Risk: The industry is exposed to foreign currency fluctuations due to imports of raw materials and exports of finished products. Significant movements in exchange rates may impact procurement costs, export realizations, and overall profitability.

Intense Market Competition: The aluminium industry remains highly competitive, with competition from domestic and international manufacturers. Pricing pressures, increased capacity additions, and changing customer preferences may affect market share and margins.
